video_title: Philadelphia 76ers Practice Media Availability 🎙️ | Labaron Philon Jr. | 10.13.26

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on his comfort level during 76ers training camp
quotes.excerpt: I feel very comfortable just being able to get in there and compete in practices.
quotes.quote: I feel very comfortable just being able to get in there and compete in practices and then having a chance in the preseason. For me, just being blessed and trying to go out there and compete every day. It is getting close to regular season now, so just looking forward, trying to give everything I got here and being in that mode where the season started now and it is on. I waited so long, but I feel like it is creeping up on me and it is finally here now.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr says he feels comfortable and ready for the regular season as he adjusts to the pace of the NBA

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on the importance of extra gym work for guards
quotes.excerpt: Being a crafty guard, being able to have multiple options, that is very important for me.
quotes.quote: Getting in the gym after practice and finding extra time to put in work and working on your craft. Being a crafty guard, being able to have multiple options, that is very important for me. The routine, coming in at the same time every morning, waking up at the same time, eating the same breakfast, it is a thing you got to repeat each and every day if you want to get better. I have been doing a great job sustaining, being on time, and being myself.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr emphasizes the importance of routine and extra gym work to develop as a crafty guard

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on his role as a ball-handling guard
quotes.excerpt: Being a ball-hawk, impacting the ball, being someone that can put pressure on the wall.
quotes.quote: Being a ball-hawk, impacting the ball, being someone that can put pressure on the wall. From that position, picking up full court, getting steals, and being at the right place at the right time. We got a lot of older guys, so those guys know how to play defense, they know the rotations, they know how to help you. Being confident that you can sustain your ground and try to play one-on-one defense a little bit to the help come. I am guarding more guards, so being able to take on the challenge is important.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr is embracing his role as a ball hawk defender for the Sixers noting he is focused on picking up full court and impacting the ball

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on the game slowing down during preseason
quotes.excerpt: I think the game really slowed down as I got better and the preseason went on.
quotes.quote: I watch a little film and talk with my coaches about the game. I think the game really slowed down as I got better and the preseason went on. Being able to make the right plays, being able to continue to get in the paint, and just be myself, be a guy that can make plays and make plays for others. If I keep doing that, I am going to be really good.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr says the game has slowed down for him throughout the preseason as he continues to focus on playmaking

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on Anthony's return to practice
quotes.excerpt: He is a very confident high-level shot maker.
quotes.quote: He looked great. Coming off screens, shooting the ball, getting into the lane, pull-ups. He is a very confident high-level shot maker. And then you put some body like me or Tyrese, guys that can get him the ball, it is really special just because he gets his shot off so quick. It is crazy. He made a lot of threes today and it was just coming off real quick actions. Having guys like that on my team, guys that can really shoot the ball, it is really helpful as a guard.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr says Anthony looked great in practice and praised his quick release as a high level shot maker

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on the benefits of playing with Anthony
quotes.excerpt: It has been a great being on his team just because I ain't got to run around all those screens.
quotes.quote: It has been a great being on his team just because I ain't got to run around all those screens. But when I am not on his team, definitely trying to get that experience of guarding a shooter like that, somebody with that much of a dead eye that can really get it off quick and make shots through contest. It has been good just to see him do that and really see him get back.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr says guarding a shooter like Anthony in practice is a great experience for his development

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on the spacing and offensive flow
quotes.excerpt: Driving in the lane, everybody is going to collapse. So it makes it easier when you got guys like KCP.
quotes.quote: Driving in the lane, everybody is going to collapse. So it makes it easier when you got guys like KCP and other guys like that being able to shoot the ball really well. Being a guy that can get in the paint as for me, being able to have guys like that around me is really special and it is a blessing. As a rookie, you don't really get to see a lot of play with a lot of guys like that. KCP is a guy that can pick and pop, KCP is a guy that can slash, and come off screens and shoot as well. That combination is really good.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr says playing alongside shooters like KCP makes it much easier for him to drive and create in the lane

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on his defensive adjustments to the NBA
quotes.excerpt: The adjustment has been good just because you got to want to compete to play that side of the floor.
quotes.quote: The adjustment has been good just because you got to want to compete to play that side of the floor. With me being a competitor, I don't think it was a thing that I really needed to harp on. It is just the little things I need to clean up, like getting stronger and adding a little bit more weight and being at the right place at the right time. My main ones were just being a ball-hawk, trying to find extra plays to help us win a game or give us the edge on somebody.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr says his main defensive focus as a rookie is getting stronger and being in the right place at the right time

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on Anthony's pick-and-roll development
quotes.excerpt: It has been really good just to see him in practice being able to handle the pick and roll well.
quotes.quote: It has been really good just to see him in practice being able to handle the pick and roll well. Guys not really getting behind him for lobs and stuff like that. If you see that as a big, that is what you want to see, not letting guys get behind him. But I feel like he has been doing pretty well and his practice level has went up. I see him and Brown working out in the mornings in the same spot, working on moves and stuff like that. We got to trust and believe that he is going to be ready each and every night.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr says Anthony has been handling the pick and roll well in practice and looks ready for the season

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on the spacing difference between college and NBA
quotes.excerpt: The spacing is really more space on the court and you got to be able to knock down shots.
quotes.quote: The spacing is really more space on the court and you got to be able to knock down shots. Guys are going to be in gaps and different teams got different schemes. Knowing the scheme of the team, knowing the scout reports, that is important just like it is in college. Any thing in game, I would say the space really, just knowing what to be on the court, know how to space on offense and know how to be at the right places at the right time on defense.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr notes that the biggest adjustment from college to the NBA is the increased spacing on the court
